ns2:section.sectionText: TOPIC: " The Franco period in first person: autobiographies from Spanish women writers 1939-1975." Course meets for 8 weeks of the semester only (March 12- May 2, 2012). All seats restricted during the early registration period. This restriction will be lifted on November 30, 2009 by 9:00 a.m. Students must meet the prerequisite requirements for this course (found in the Catalog Entry) or will be told to drop on the first day of classes. Non-registered students are not allowed to sit in or audit.
